snippet_primary: "Integrates Payhip into WordPress. When a Payhip product page link is clicked, it will open a Payhip 'Buy' box. To use, just install and activate the plugin. There are no settings, it will automatically work on all links to Payhip product pages, both existing and new ones."
subject_exact: WP Payhip Integration plugin opening a Payhip Buy box on product links automatically with no settings
